title: Worksheet 5: Conditionals
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: A conditional is a part of a computer program that makes a decision based on whether something is true or false. Conditionals are often written using the words "if" and "else." For example, a program might say: "If it is raining, then show an umbrella icon. Else, show a sun icon." The program checks the condition ("is it raining?") and only runs the matching instruction. Conditionals allow programs to react differently depending on different situations, instead of always doing the exact same thing every time. Video games use conditionals constantly. For example: "If the player's health reaches 0, then show the 'Game Over' screen. Else, keep playing." Without conditionals, computer programs could not make decisions or respond differently to different inputs.
